ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.label: ration post
ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.leavesWhy: the Republic's clerk takes the post, its table and its tents on to the next road

texts.li: A clerk and two guards of {FACTION} are coming in along the road with crates of rations, {X_nameDef} at the front. They will keep a ration post by the colony's road for a week.
[lowtech] A clerk of {FACTION} and two of its guard are walking in along the road with sacks of grain and dried meat. They will hand out food to the hungry by the colony's road for seven days.

{X_nameDef}, a clerk of {FACTION}, has come in along the road with two of its guards and the rations for a post by the colony's road. Anyone hungry may come, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef}, as long as they give their name for the roll.

[winter] A clerk and two guards of {FACTION} have brought crates of rations along the road for the lean months. Nobody goes hungry while the Republic stands, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and they will keep the post open for a week.

settled.li: {FACTION}'s ration post is set up {PLACE}, by the road: a fire, a table with the rations stacked on it, and a guard on either side.
The Republic's clerk has opened the ration post {PLACE}, by the road, with the roll book on the table and the rations behind it.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef}, one of the guards at the ration post {PLACE}, says {X_pronoun} has handed out enough rations, and asks whether there is a place for {X_objective} at the colony.
{X_nameDef} of the ration post says {X_pronoun} has filled in enough forms for one life, and asks whether the colony would take in someone who keeps good records.

farewell.li: [fed,riot] The Republic's ration post packed up and went on to the next road. It fed {FED} of the hungry while it stood, though the queue came to blows once when the rations ran out.
[fed,turned] The Republic's ration post packed up and went on to the next road, having fed {FED} of the hungry; its guards turned one away who came from a people at war with the Republic.
[fed] The Republic's ration post packed up and went on to the next road. It fed {FED} of the hungry while it stood by the colony.
The Republic's ration post packed up its table and tents and went on to the next road.

lines.li: One ration each, and keep the line straight.
Everyone counted, everyone fed.
Your name for the roll, please.
There is a form for that.
The Republic never fell.
[morning] Post's open, form a line.
Name, town and how many in your household.
[evening] Count what's left and write it down.
Everyone gets the same, that's the law.

momentLines.li: [short] The rations are gone until the next delivery.
[turned] Your people are at war with the Republic, so there's nothing here for you.
[ration] Sign here, and here's your ration.
[ration] One each, and please keep the line moving.
[short] We've handed out the last of it, the next crates are on the way.

helpTexts.li: [tales] {A_nameDef} sat by the ration post's fire and heard how the old postmaster read the laws aloud on the radio every evening until other towns answered.
[tales] {A_nameDef} sat by the ration post's fire and heard {X_nameDef} recite the first article of the old laws from memory.

li.label: Sell the post food at the Republic's price (20 meals)
li.tip: One of the colony carries twenty meals out to the ration post, and the clerk pays the Republic's fixed price for them. The post can feed the hungry for longer.

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} has come up from the ration post by the road. There are more hungry on the road than the post has rations for, {X_pronoun} says, and asks whether the colony would sell it twenty meals at the Republic's price.

refused.li: {X_nameDef} notes it in the roll book and goes back to the post.

outcomes.li: Twenty meals are going out to the ration post, and the clerk will pay for them.

li.label: Draw rations on the colony's ration cards
li.tip: As citizens of the Republic (the colony holds its papers), the colony may draw rations at the post: a ration for each of its people, set down by the post's fire for the colony to fetch.

outcomes.li: The clerk checks the colony's papers and sets its rations down by the post's fire.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to see to the hurt at the post
li.tip: The colony's doctor goes over to the ration post and tends whoever is hurt, with the colony's medicine where there is any.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the ration post to see to the hurt.

ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.label: landing party
ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.leavesWhy: the landing party leaves the ground as they found it, as the Fleet's rule says

texts.li: A landing party of {FACTION} is walking in from where their shuttle set them down, {X_nameDef} at the front, in step. They will camp by the colony for some days and survey the land.
[lowtech] A party of {FACTION}'s crew is walking in, {X_nameDef} at the front, with a chain and stakes for measuring. They will camp by the colony for some days and survey the land.

{X_nameDef} has led a landing party of {FACTION} in to camp by the colony, every one of them in uniform and in step. They have orders to survey the land, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef}, and to log everything they find.

[spring] A landing party of {FACTION} is walking in, {X_nameDef} at the front, to camp by the colony while the weather is good. The ship wants the land surveyed, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef}, for when the order to disembark comes.

settled.li: {FACTION}'s landing party has made camp {PLACE}: one shelter with the bunks in a row, the fire laid square, and a watch posted.
The landing party is set up {PLACE}, everything stowed and logged, and the first watch has been rung.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef}, a deckhand of the landing party camped {PLACE}, asks to disembark here and join the colony. The officer has told {X_objective} it isn't allowed, but {X_pronoun} has been holding position all {X_possessive} life and would rather live on the ground.

{X_nameDef} of the landing party {PLACE} has come over on {X_possessive} own and asks whether the colony would take {X_objective} in. The officer would not give leave, {X_pronoun} says, but {X_pronoun} is tired of waiting for an order that never comes.

farewell.li: [deserter] The landing party struck camp and walked off toward their shuttle, one fewer than came, the officer logging it without a word.
[warned] The landing party struck camp and walked off toward their shuttle. Their watch was the first to see the raiders come.
[surveyed] The landing party struck camp and walked off toward their shuttle, with {SURVEYED} places on the colony's land surveyed and logged.
The landing party struck camp and walked off toward their shuttle.

lines.li: Holding position.
Log it, all of it.
For when the order comes.
Bunks squared away by the first bell.
Every watch is kept.
[morning] Report to your posts.
[night] Second watch, wake me if anything moves.
Note the bearing and log it.
The ship is holding position, and so are we.

momentLines.li: [bell] Change of the watch, ring the bell.
[deserter] Nobody gave you leave to disembark.
[raiders] Raiders on the horizon, warn the colony.
[survey] Mark it on the chart, there's good water here.

helpTexts.li: [tales] {A_nameDef} sat with the landing party by their fire and heard how Captain Sallow kept the crew at their posts after the ship came down.
[tales] {A_nameDef} sat with the landing party by their fire and heard what was written in the ship's log on the day it came down.

li.label: Sell them a week's meals (12 meals)
li.tip: One of the colony carries twelve meals out to the landing party, and they pay for them at their price.

askTexts.li: {X_nameDef} has come over from the landing party's camp. Their rations are running low, {X_pronoun} says, and asks whether the colony would sell them twelve meals.

refused.li: {X_nameDef} says they will go on half rations.

outcomes.li: Twelve meals are going out to the landing party, who will pay for them.

li.label: Ask their medic to see to {A_nameDef}
li.tip: The landing party's medic comes over to {A_nameDef}'s side and tends {A_objective}, as they would one of the crew.

outcomes.li: The landing party's medic is coming over to see to {A_nameDef}.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to see to their sick
li.tip: The colony's doctor goes over to the landing party's camp and tends whoever of them is sick or hurt, with the colony's medicine where there is any.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the landing party's camp to see to their sick.

ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.label: field lab
ColonyCouncil.CampKindDef.leavesWhy: the Works pack their samples and their table and take them back to the vats

texts.li: Two sequencers and a vat-keeper of {FACTION} are walking in with sample cases, {X_nameDef} at the front. They will camp by the colony for a week and sample the land's beasts and plants.
[lowtech] Three of {FACTION} are walking in with boxes and jars, {X_nameDef} at the front. They will camp by the colony for some days and take samples of the land's beasts and plants.

{X_nameDef} and two others of {FACTION} are walking in with their sample cases to camp by the colony for a week. They want to know what lives on the colony's land, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef}, and they will take nothing from anyone without asking.

[summer] With the land at its greenest, three of {FACTION} are walking in to camp by the colony and sample its plants and beasts. {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that every sample would be written in the ledger.

settled.li: {FACTION}'s field lab is set up {PLACE}: tents, a fire, and a table covered with sample jars.
The Works' people have made camp {PLACE} and laid out their sample cases on a table by the fire.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef} of the field lab camped {PLACE} says {X_pronoun} has spent enough of {X_possessive} life in the vat halls, and asks whether there is a place for {X_objective} at the colony.
{X_nameDef} of the field lab says {X_pronoun} would like to live among people who were born rather than grown, and asks whether there is a place for {X_objective} at the colony.

farewell.li: [loose] The field lab packed up and went back to the vats, without the beast that got loose.
[sampled] The field lab packed up its sample cases and went back to the vats, with {SAMPLED} samples of the colony's land.
The field lab packed up and went back to the vats.

lines.li: Every body is a draft.
Ask before you change it.
Label that jar before it goes in the case.
The vats are warm, and the work goes on.
Hold still, it's only a sample.
[morning] Fresh cases, fresh labels.
Write it in the ledger before you forget.
Nothing is changed without asking.
[evening] Seal the cases for the night.

momentLines.li: [loose] The beast is loose, keep away from it.
[gene] It's written in, and the work went well.
[sample] Label it, date it, into the case.
[drawn] That's all we need, thank you for letting us.

helpTexts.li: [tales] {A_nameDef} sat with the Works' people by their fire and heard how the people the lab had grown kept the vats warm through the winter after its founders left.
[tales] {A_nameDef} sat with the Works' people by their fire and heard why their children choose their own genes when they are old enough.

li.label: Ask for one of their genes for one of the colony ({COUNT} silver)
li.tip: One of the sequencers writes one of the Works' genes into a colonist who could take one, at the colonist's side, two hours' work. The colonist's body gets the game's mark of a xenogerm replicating afterwards.

outcomes.li: A sequencer of the field lab will come and do the gene work.

li.label: Let them draw a sample from the colony's rarest blood
li.tip: One of the sequencers draws a little blood from the colonist whose genes are rarest to the Works, at their side, and the Works pay for it.

outcomes.li: A sequencer of the field lab will come and draw the sample.

li.label: Sell them a genepack
li.tip: One of the colony carries a genepack out to the field lab, and the Works pay for it.

outcomes.li: A genepack is going out to the field lab, and the Works will pay for it.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to see to their sick
li.tip: The colony's doctor goes over to the field lab and tends whoever of them is sick or hurt, with the colony's medicine where there is any.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} is going over to the field lab to see to their sick.
